newsitem.title: ESTONIA: RAKVERE SUSPENDED AMID INSIDER CHARGES.
newsitem.headline: RAKVERE SUSPENDED AMID INSIDER CHARGES.

text.p: The Tallinn stock exchange said on Wednesday that it has suspended trade in Rakvere Meat Factory shares as criminal charges have been initiated for alleged insider trading in the stock.
The securities commission said in a statement that it has asked the police to initiate charges for illegal dealing in Rakvere shares.
"The reason was deals made by persons who possessed confidential information at a time when possession of information could have an impact on the securities price," the securities commission added.

Rakvere shares gained nearly 10 percent on May 14 and May 15 and just before trading closed on May 15, the company informed the stock exchange that it had bought a majority stake in leading Latvian meat producer Rigas Miesnieks.

"The securities commission suspects that before the release of official information on the bourse and on news agencies the data was used in a price sensitive period for personal interests," deputy director of the securities commission, Indrek Jakobson, told Reuters.
Jakobson said he will not give any further details of who is to be charged before a court decision but said there were several investors.
"This is a precedent in Estonia which has an enormous impact for the Estonian market," he added.
